TUT_001.headline: TIME
TUT_001.body: Battles here are not won by the quickest fingers. Press Space to pause. Issue your orders. Resume when ready — the chroniclers will remember what you chose, not how fast you chose it.

TUT_002.headline: SELECTION
TUT_002.body: A commander who points without looking is a commander who counts losses afterward. Click a cohort to single it out, or drag a frame across several to take a group under your eye.

TUT_003.headline: MOVEMENT
TUT_003.body: Terrain remembers. Right-click the ground where you would have your chosen cohort stand — they will march as ordered, neither faster nor wiser than the path you laid.

TUT_004.headline: OBJECTIVES
TUT_004.body: Histories are not won by survival alone, but by satisfying the list a future chronicler will check against. The day's terms are written in the panel marked above and to the right.

TUT_005.headline: CHRONICLE
TUT_005.body: Every charge, every retreat, every unit spent enters the record. In the generations that follow, scribes will compress this hour into a single sentence — and your hand will be the verb at the center of it.
